views.title: (1) Rapid Dev

summary:
Rapid 2.5.7 (Meta's AI-assisted OpenStreetMap editor), loaded with Three Rivers, MI data. The user was already signed in, so no sign-in steps were needed. 5 views saved:
1. map-editor: the main workspace, with the map and imagery, the feature search sidebar, the Point/Line/Area toolbar, the Rapid toggle, Undo/Save and the map controls.
2. feature-inspector: an insurance office opened through the URL `id` parameter. The left inspector shows the feature type, fields (name, address, hours, phone, website) and tags.
3. map-data-pane: the right-hand Map Data pane (data layers, QA services, photo overlays, style options) with the notes layer turned on. Its replay passed, but notes didn't show up on the map in my session.
4. rapid-suggestion: a selected Esri address-point suggestion, with the Rapid sidebar showing its tags and Add/Ignore buttons.
5. upload-changeset: the Upload to OpenStreetMap panel after accepting that suggestion and typing a changeset comment. The edit is only replayed locally and never uploaded.

Three views (map-data-pane, rapid-suggestion, upload-changeset) rely on clicks at x/y screen positions, because the map-control buttons have no accessible names and map features have no text to target. All replays matched.

Not captured: the Background, Issues, Preferences and Help panes, which are near-duplicates of the Map Data pane. Also not captured: the history panel and note threads.
